'''Voren'thal the Scryer''' is a magister<ref name="A Good Day"/> and former advisor to Prince [[Kael'thas Sunstrider]], and a current member of the [[Regency Council]] of [[Alah'Thalas]]. He has long lived under the roof of Lord [[Astalor Sunsworn]] in Alah'Thalas, enjoying his patronage and basking in borrowed wealth and influence, and is believed to be nothing more than a puppet to Lord Sunsworn.<ref name="A Good Day"/>

When Lord Sunsworn made a motion before the Council to be named Lord-Regent of Quel'Thalas following the retaking of [[Shalandis Isle]] by the [[Silver Covenant]], Voren'thal voted in his favor.<ref name="A Good Day"/>

==Quotes==
In a bygone era, I stood as the closest confidant and advisor to Prince Kael'thas, watching with sorrow as he forsook us, seduced by the malevolent powers of the Legion.

Though I yearn for his return, the wisps of foresight that caress my ancient senses reveal a path fraught with uncertainty.

Hope lingers, but I am no fool. In the absence of our prince, we must face the harsh reality and select a temporary leader to guide our people through these tumultuous times.
